{
  "test_name": "Case 3: Arrays",
  "description": "Validate array type preservation: int[], bool[], float[], string[], mixed[]",
  "input": {
    "int_array": [
      1,
      2,
      3,
      42,
      100
    ],
    "bool_array": [
      true,
      false,
      true
    ],
    "float_array": [
      1.1,
      2.2,
      3.14
    ],
    "string_array": [
      "foo",
      "bar",
      "baz"
    ],
    "mixed_array": [
      1,
      "two",
      3.0,
      true,
      null
    ]
  },
  "expected_output": {
    "int_array": [
      1,
      2,
      3,
      42,
      100
    ],
    "bool_array": [
      true,
      false,
      true
    ],
    "float_array": [
      1.1,
      2.2,
      3.14
    ],
    "string_array": [
      "foo",
      "bar",
      "baz"
    ],
    "mixed_array": [
      1,
      "two",
      3.0,
      true,
      null
    ]
  },
  "validation_strategy": "field_by_field_comparison",
  "type_check": "type(returned_value) == type(original_value)",
  "value_check": "returned_value == original_value"
}

metadata.specification: Cross-Vessel Type Preservation and Data Integrity Validation
